premises.text: Traditional recruitment methods favor prestige over potential, leading to overlooked high-potential candidates.
premises.evidence_span: evaluation today are based on criteria such as well-known schools or well-known companies. They favor prestige over potential.

premises.text: Deep learning technology can qualify diverse experiences and backgrounds in resumes.
premises.evidence_span: Our unique deep learning technology is able to qualify every experience, project, education or transition people can write down in their resumes.

premises.text: The system can assess both technical and non-technical jobs across all languages and media formats.
premises.evidence_span: we are able to assess both technical and non-technical jobs. We are able to scale to all languages. And finally, we can deal with all media formats from PDF to images.

premises.text: Reminder can process a high volume of applications efficiently.
premises.evidence_span: we already reached the milestone of processing 10,000 applications per week.

premises.text: Clients can identify more relevant talents and reduce the number of interviews needed.
premises.evidence_span: We allow our clients identify three times more relevant talents in their initial pools and reduce by 80% the number of interviews they do before making a hiring decision.
